change_reason: Increase the Gurobi limit to 300 seconds per optimization stage; instances, methods, repetitions and measured outcomes are unchanged.

replication_rule.buses: replicate the complete eight-bus block with new contiguous IDs
replication_rule.trips: replicate every route block with the corresponding new bus and trip IDs
replication_rule.chargers: one charger per bus; replicate nameplate power exactly
replication_rule.prices: hold the same 48-interval price process fixed
replication_rule.initial_and_terminal_soc: hold the same per-bus fractions fixed
replication_rule.day_ahead_energy_and_site_exchange: replicate per-bus trajectories and scale site buy/sell linearly

benchmark.solver_time_limit_scope: per optimization stage or standalone solve
benchmark.reason: Measure one pricing/optimization/evaluation attempt per genuine event decision without multiplying solver time by evaluator reruns.
separate_metrics: solver wall time, variables, constraints, gap, nodes, and iterations

storage: Generated Excel inputs and run workbooks remain ignored local artifacts; code, protocol, manifests, and compact summaries are versioned.
